 Why I'm Buying This Market Crash
 Nov 20, 2026, 1:49 PM ET S&P 500 Index (SP500) , COMP Stock , SMH , SPY , SPX , VOO , QQQ , IWM , DIA , NDX , DJI 5 Comments Yiannis Zourmpanos 18.45K Followers Follow Summary
 The S&P 500 has corrected 8%, Nasdaq 100 15%, and semiconductors 30%, creating selective AI buying opportunities.
 Bank of America reports technology overweights collapsing from 37% to 12%, while institutional cash allocations remain unusually low.
 Margin debt remains near $1.45 trillion, down just 3.6% from its peak, suggesting limited investor deleveraging.
 Extreme fear readings of 19 contrast with 70.1% retail equity allocations, raising doubts about genuine market capitulation.
 After moving entirely into cash in September, I am gradually buying AI infrastructure while maintaining 22% liquidity.
